title: Rust: Align TX queue with Python oracles
description: Part of TX Queue / Forwarding Buffer oracles (queue)
close_reason: Aligned Rust TX queue with Python oracle: added dst_addr and channel fields to TxItem, added packets_transmitted counter, renamed packets_preempted to packets_dropped_preempt for consistency, added clear() and confirm_transmitted() methods, updated push() signature to accept dst_addr and channel parameters, added new tests for new functionality.
